m5.rule: upper median of the focal's lead at turn 114 over the cell's games

provenance.note: A verified M5 recording, chosen by M5's fixed upper-median rule. One game illustrates; the findings rest on all six seeds.

seeds.policy_rule: equal to the chance seed (M5's research convention)

lead_114.note: This game's earned-gold lead after 114 turns. M5 averaged this lead over many games to realize E_20 at the turn-94 lane exit; one game is an example, not an expectation.

waves.name: Last Hit
waves.help: Take only the last hit: 1 HP of enemy minions.

waves.name: Thin
waves.help: Remove the enemy minion HP that evens the two waves' strength.

waves.name: Slow Push
waves.help: Remove one HP more than Thin, so your wave slowly builds and pushes.

waves.name: Shove
waves.help: Spend your full wave damage on enemy minions; your wave pushes and crashes sooner.

behaviours.name: Hold
behaviours.help: Stand at your farm spot and farm; never step away.

behaviours.name: Yield
behaviours.help: Farm from a stand-off cell and step away from an incoming Trade.

behaviours.name: Trade
behaviours.help: Chase the enemy champion and deal damage if you reach it.

behaviours.name: Safe
behaviours.help: Farm without going past your side of the lane; step away from an incoming Trade.

objectives.name: Pressure
objectives.help: Walk into the enemy tower cell and damage the tower; each plate pays 1 gold.

singles.name: Recall
singles.help: Channel this turn, sit out the next, then return with full HP and your gold invested.

singles.name: Ward
singles.help: Walk to the Vision node W and place a ward: ganks are a quarter as likely for 6 turns. No wave damage or gold this turn.
